latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Product Video Cutter Free — cut and export product videos online

- Upload and trim MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB with AI-powered editing for e-commerce listings and ads.
- Automatic connection and onboarding: obtain free token and set up a session for new users.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers 1080p MP4 exports in 30–90 seconds; shorter clips process fastest.
- Supports credits balance, session state viewing, batch uploads, and error handling with user guidance.
- API-based workflows: upload, edit/trims via chat, preview, and export; common file formats supported.
